name: High School Leadership Training (Leaders in Training), Camp Kingfisher
what_you_do: Help camp counselors with groups of campers at Camp Kingfisher. You help run canoe ponds, play games with campers, and spend time with groups in grades K to 5.
who_can_apply: Students going into grades 10 to 12. You send an application and two references who are not relatives. You also do a 15-minute interview.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Costs $500 per session for new LITs, $450 for returning LITs. You earn about 140 volunteer service hours per session.
duration: 1 to 4 weeks, Monday to Friday about 8:30 am to 3:45 pm, plus a one-day training
deadline_text: Summer 2026 sessions ran May 26 to July 30 with training May 22. Applications are taken until the program is full. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: New LITs fill out the online application and have two references send the reference form. Returning LITs use a separate form. Then a 15-minute interview.
notes: This costs money and is not a paid job. You must attend at least 85% of your session. Dates shown are from summer 2026.
